gameDescription.shortDescription: A tactile Mahjong-inspired puzzle game set in a cozy night-time game room.
gameDescription.fullDescription: Each safe contains a Mahjong board with a hidden rule. Study the tiles, spot the pattern, and solve the lock before time runs out.

content.item: Up to three stars per level

gameplay.objective: Solve the hidden rule on each Mahjong board and open the safe.

section.heading: Your Goal
section.text: Every safe holds a mahjong board hiding a secret. Solve the rule shown in the HUD to open it.
There are 100 safes across 10 chapters. New rules are introduced a few at a time, so you always know what to do.

section.heading: Four Moves
section.text: Tap — select a tile to answer a puzzle.
Swipe — drag across a tile to rotate it 90°.
Hold — long-press a tile to peek at its hidden back.
Swap — tap two tiles to exchange their positions.

section.heading: Submitting
section.text: Tap-order puzzles check as you go. Transform puzzles (swap / rotate) need you to pull the safe handle, or press Confirm, to submit your answer.

section.heading: Three Levels of Help
section.text: The HUD hint button gives up to three hints per level.
Hint 1 explains the rule. Hint 2 points out what to look for. Hint 3 lights up the exact tiles.

section.heading: Earning Stars
section.text: Every level starts at 3 stars.
Use a hint and you lose a star. Beat the time targets and you keep them.
Slower than the two-star or three-star par time costs you a star each.

section.heading: Timed Safes
section.text: Chapter 9 safes tick down in real time. Open them before the clock runs out — or the safe slams shut and you retry.

section.heading: The Lone Tile
section.text: Every tile appears in pairs — except one. Tap the tile that appears exactly once.

section.heading: The Only Pair
section.text: Every tile appears once — except a single identical pair. Tap both tiles of that pair.

section.heading: The Impostor
section.text: One tile breaks a visible pattern (for example, the only non-sequence tile). Spot it and tap it.

section.heading: Count & Click
section.text: Count how many times each tile type appears on the board, then tap one tile of each type from most frequent to least frequent.

section.heading: The Winding Path
section.text: The tiles hide a path. Tap them in the order the path winds across the board.

section.heading: Mirror Image
section.text: The board must end up as the mirror of its current layout. Swap tiles to match the reflection, then submit.

section.heading: The Shuffle
section.text: The tiles are scrambled from a hidden order. Swap them back into the correct arrangement, then submit.

section.heading: Set Upright
section.text: Some tiles lie on their side. Swipe each tilted tile until every one stands upright, then submit.

section.heading: Point Inward
section.text: Each tile should point toward the center of the board. Rotate the arrows until all point inward, then submit.

section.heading: Hidden Marks
section.text: Every tile hides a mark on its back. Long-press to peek, find the tile whose mark is different, and tap it.

section.heading: The Gap
section.text: One tile is missing from the board. Tap the gap, then pick the correct tile from the rack below.

section.heading: The Substitute
section.text: One tile on the board is wrong. Tap it, then choose the correct replacement from the rack.

section.heading: Multi-Rule Safes
section.text: Late chapters chain several rules into one safe. The HUD shows you each step as you reach it.
Complete each sub-task in order — the safe only opens once every link of the chain is solved.

section.heading: Tips
section.text: Use moves deliberately: fewer moves and no hints keep all three stars.
Stuck? A hint costs a star but never locks the level.

dailyChallenge.title: Today's hand
dailyChallenge.description: Each row steps up or down by 1. Tap the one number that cheats · any row order.

oneMinuteDeal.title: One-minute deal
oneMinuteDeal.description: Start with 60 seconds. Every table opened adds five more. See how long your hands hold up.

mainMenu.title: Mah Safe
mainMenu.subtitle: Tiles, tells, and a stubborn brass lock

page.title: Open the Vault
page.body: Each safe hides one correct answer. Study the tiles, then tap, rotate, flip or swap to match it before the safe seals.

page.title: Four Ways to Play
page.body: Tap to pick, swipe to rotate, long-press to peek behind a tile, and tap two tiles to swap them. The instruction bar tells you which move a puzzle wants.

page.title: Hints & Stars
page.body: Stuck? Use a hint — three levels of help, and fewer hints means a higher star rating. Perfect runs earn special achievements.
